name: Tahiti
tagline: Black-sand beaches, waterfalls and the gateway to Polynesia
summary: Tahiti is French Polynesia's main island, with the lively port of Papeete, black-sand beaches and jungle valleys. Browse the Papeete market, feast at the roulottes food trucks, see Point Venus, watch Teahupo'o's giant waves and take the ferry to dramatic Moorea.
seasonNote: The dry season (May to October) is best; November to April is hot and wet with cyclone risk.
arrival: Faa'a International Airport is 15 minutes from Papeete.
gettingAround: Rental car or le truck buses; ferries to Moorea take 45 minutes.
cashTip: Prices are shown in euros; locally you pay in CFP francs (XPF), pegged at about 119 XPF to 1 euro. Resorts take cards; carry some francs for snacks and boats.
foodTip: Poisson cru, roulottes food trucks and tropical fruit.
buyTip: Black pearls, pareos and monoi oil.
